audit.whatIsWrong: The entry's central premise is that Ziggs out-ranges Galio enormously: spikes[0] 'his Bouncing Bomb (Q) pokes you off the wave from a screen away', early 'he pokes with long-range Bouncing Bombs from beyond your fixed E dash', whys[0] 'Ziggs Bouncing-Bombs you from outside your fixed E dash'.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 850 range. Winds of War is 825. The gap is twenty-five units, not a screen. Everything else Ziggs owns does out-range Galio — Satchel Charge 1000, Hexplosive Minefield 900, Mega Inferno Bomb 5000 — but the ability the page builds its despair around is the one that is effectively level. A Galio told he cannot answer the Q will never contest a poke war he is only 25 units short of.
audit.corrected: Bouncing Bomb is 850 to your 825 — you are twenty-five units short, not out-classed. Trade tornado for bomb; what actually out-ranges you is the 1000-range Satchel Charge and the 900-range minefield.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (Q range 850; W range 1000; E range 900; R range 5000)

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. mid says 'wait out his W and Minefield before any all-in' and wants.you[1] says 'Wait out his Satchel Charge and Minefield' — neither says how long, and no other number appears in either layer.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12 and Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16 — those two numbers are the entire all-in plan and they are long enough to genuinely wait out. Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 falling to 4s, which is why the poke war never stops, and Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70 at 5000 range.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge 20s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s — those are the two you wait out. Bouncing Bomb is 6s falling to 4s, so the poke never stops. Mega Inferno Bomb 120s at 5000 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Galio wins 38.46% of 39 games — one of the two worst numbers in this slice — and the page says diff 'EVEN', tone yellow, difficulty 6/10, report[14] 'Even matchup'. The stage chart gives Galio four of seven rows while whys[0], whys[1], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] all describe Ziggs winning those stages.

audit.corrected: HARD, tone #ff5d6c, difficulty 8/10, chart Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Galio, Ziggs, Ziggs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and breakdown.early credit 'your passive shield' with blanking his chip, and content.late says 'Your Shield of Durand does nothing when he never commits a combo at point-blank range'.
audit.why: Two different errors about the same button. Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, an empowered basic attack, not a shield — the magic shield belongs to Shield of Durand and is 7.5% of maximum health at rank 1, restoring only after 12 seconds without taking damage, which constant bomb chip denies outright. And the active stance reduces damage taken wherever you are standing; it is the taunt that needs him close, not the reduction. Against an all-magic champion the stance cuts 25% at rank 1 rising to 45%, which is the most it will ever do in any matchup.
audit.corrected: The shield is Shield of Durand's passive, 7.5% max health, and bomb chip stops it recharging. The active reduction works at any range and cuts 25-45% of magic — only the taunt needs him close.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (W passive shield 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health, restores after 12/10/8s without taking damage; active magic 25/30/35/40/45%)

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why says 'the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight'.
audit.why: Justice Punch cannot be interrupted once travelling and Ziggs has no root — his kit is a slow on Hexplosive Minefield and a knockback on Satchel Charge. The knockback is the real answer to a Galio engage and it also moves Ziggs himself, which is what actually breaks the follow-up.
audit.corrected: Ziggs has no root. Satchel Charge is the answer to your engage: it knocks you away and moves Ziggs too, so even a landed punch leaves you with nothing to taunt.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch cannot be interrupted mid-travel)
champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (W Satchel Charge: 'knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage'; E slow; no root)

audit.whatIsWrong: Short Fuse is never mentioned, and Satchel Charge's percent-health component is never mentioned.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags both: 'autoreset-burst-tell: Ziggs's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Short Fuse (P))' and 'Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge (W)) — raw armour or MR is the wrong answer here'. Short Fuse's cooldown shortens every time he casts an ability, so a Ziggs spamming a 4-second Bouncing Bomb has an empowered auto almost permanently — which matters the moment you do reach him. And building MR against a percent-health Satchel Charge is the standard mistake in this matchup, one the page's own 'Build MR' line in wants.you[2] walks straight into.
audit.corrected: Short Fuse's empowered auto comes back faster every time he casts, so he is not defenceless up close. Satchel Charge carries percent-health damage, so MR alone is not the answer — health is.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (P Short Fuse: 'This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability', flags autoReset; W flags knockup, percentHealth)

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 advice is 'shove and drop on bot or a fight' with no mention of the ultimate timing risk.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance channels 2.75 seconds and is CC-immune only after 1.25. Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 units and Satchel Charge knocks up — either can land inside that first 1.25-second window, and Ziggs is the one champion on this list who can do it from outside your vision.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance is CC-immune only after 1.25 of its 2.75 seconds, and his ultimate reaches 5000 — start the channel out of his line of sight, not in front of the wave.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC immunity after 1.25s)

audit.why: The packet flags five probable wrong names. Four are false positives — 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield', 'Your Shield of Durand', "Winds of War's", "Shield of Durand's". The fifth is real: early says 'long-range Bouncing Bombs' where the ability is Bouncing Bomb, singular. My early rewrite drops the plural.

edits.before: Ziggs is the exact champ you cannot punish: he pokes with long-range Bouncing Bombs from beyond your fixed E dash and never has to commit a combo into your face for Shield of Durand to block. Don't waste Winds of War as poke — its converging windblasts are too slow to catch a backpedaling mage; cast the tornado only to clear the wave so you can hold a tradeable HP bar. Your single window is level 3: if he overextends to last-hit, E (Justice Punch) into him and channel W, because the magic-amplified reduction lets you survive the bomb he throws back and land the taunt.
edits.after: Ziggs is the champ you cannot punish, but not because of the Q: Bouncing Bomb is 850 against your 825 and you lose that exchange on its 6-second cooldown, not on range. What genuinely out-reaches you is the 1000-range Satchel Charge and the 900-range minefield. Don't spend Winds of War as poke — the converging windblasts are slow enough for a backpedaling mage to walk out of; cast the tornado to clear the wave and hold a tradeable HP bar. Your one window is level 3: if he oversteps, punch in and channel W, because the stance cuts 25% of magic at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he out-ranges you again — every time you reach E distance he can Satchel Charge himself backward, and his Minefield turns your only approach lane into chip damage before you arrive. Stop forcing the 1v1. At 6, Hero's Entrance changes what the matchup even is: you can't kill a respectful Ziggs in lane, but you out-roam a stationary siege mage, so shove and drop on bot or a fight. Wait out his W and Minefield before any all-in, then E-flash in and W-taunt before he repositions.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he out-ranges you again — every time you reach 650 he Satchel Charges himself backward on a 20-second cooldown, and the flat 16-second minefield turns your only approach into chip. Stop forcing the 1v1. At 6, Hero's Entrance changes what the matchup is, but the channel is 2.75 seconds and only CC-immune after 1.25, and his ultimate reaches 5000 — start it out of his line. Wait out the W and the minefield before any all-in, then E-flash in and taunt.

edits.before: This stays bad if you treat it as a duel — Ziggs sieges from a screen away, his Mega Inferno Bomb (R) can finish you from off-screen, and your tanky-AP damage plateaus while his poke scales with item siege. Your Shield of Durand does nothing when he never commits a combo at point-blank range. Win by being a map piece, not a laner: use Hero's Entrance to engage him in fights where your team collapses before his artillery range matters, and never walk a lane lined with his Minefield.
edits.after: This stays bad if you treat it as a duel — Ziggs sieges from a screen away, Mega Inferno Bomb finishes you from 5000 units, and your tanky-AP damage plateaus while his poke scales. The stance still cuts 25-45% of everything he throws; it is the taunt that does nothing when he never comes close. Win by being a map piece: use Hero's Entrance to engage him in fights where your team collapses first, buy health rather than pure MR against his percent-health W, and never walk a lane lined with mines.

notes: The 'Ziggs out-ranges you' framing was the load-bearing error: Bouncing Bomb is 850 against Winds of War's 825, a 25-unit gap, while the page called it 'a screen away' and 'beyond your fixed E dash'. His real range advantages are Satchel Charge at 1000, Hexplosive Minefield at 900 and Mega Inferno Bomb at 5000. wants.you[2] still says 'Build MR', which is the wrong lever against a percent-health Satchel Charge — I flagged it under point 4 but the line is 116 characters of mostly-correct advice about channelling the stance, so I left it rather than spend the band on a half-rewrite. Galio facts verified at wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio and reused across this slice: Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half; its passive is a magic shield of 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health restoring after 12/10/8s without taking damage; taunt on release. Justice Punch knocks up 0.75s, cannot be interrupted mid-travel, disabled while Grounded, halts on terrain or champions. Winds of War 825, tornado 2s, no slow. Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC-immune after 1.25s. Colossal Smash is a 5s empowered auto scaling with 60% bonus MR. Galio kit-file flag misfires: E tagged 'terrain' and missing 'knockup' despite Riot's description.
